title: Vegetarian French Gratin
description: A delicious and comforting French-inspired gratin made with light and aromatic vegetables.

ingredients.name: Light vegetables (such as zucchini and bell peppers)
Aromatic vegetables (such as onions and garlic)

instructions: Peel and slice the light vegetables into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
Sauté the aromatic vegetables in olive oil until softened.
Combine the sautéed vegetables and sliced light vegetables in a baking dish.
Sprinkle the shredded French cheese over the vegetables.
Pour the grated gratin over the cheese.
Season with salt, pepper, and a sprig of fresh thyme.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the vegetables are tender.
